plainText:
Yuko Sanpei (Japanese: 三瓶由布子 Sanpei Yūko) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Sanpei was born on February 28, 1986, in , . As an adult, she became a voice actress and landed a number of prominent roles in anime series since. In , she first voiced Thomas, a character of the day who appeared in . Sanpei then voiced her best-known role in Pokémon the Series, who was also named Sanpei, during . She was initially affiliated with the talent agency Gekidan Wakakusa, but left in May 2007 to freelance. Six months later, she joined . At some point, Sanpei joined Axl-One and won the Best Leading Actress Award during the of 2019. She is married with two children.
